data: Apple's net sales were $383.3 billion in fiscal 2023 (ended September 30, 2023) and $416.2 billion in fiscal 2025 (ended September 27, 2025). That is an increase of about $32.9 billion, or roughly 8.6% over the two years. These figures come from my training data, so please verify them against Apple's fiscal 2025 Form 10-K before relying on them.
